messages:
maya: CI red on release/v1.4 — decrypt step failing in gha-decrypt job. suspect auth scopes.

sam: Can you paste the decrypt error? often it's an expired SA key or runner upgrade removing gcloud creds.

maya: Here are the relevant logs from the decrypt step:
```
decrypt: failed to decrypt secrets: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Request had insufficient authentication scopes.
stderr: googleapi: Error 403: Permission denied, insufficient authentication scopes
```

sam: Likely the self-hosted runner lost GCP creds after the runner upgrade. Which runner was used?

maya: runner= self-hosted-us-east-2-3. deploy-bot shows that runner was upgraded last night. Can someone check the GCP SA key in repo secrets?

deploy-bot: Notice: runner self-hosted-us-east-2-3 upgraded to v2.307.3 (2026-03-15) :information_source:

tian: I can check. Maya, drop the job URL and I'll try a rerun if it's transient.

maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/runs/1234567890/jobs/445566

sam: Before rerun, verify the secret GCP_SA_KEY in redwood-inference/infra — rotation might have failed. Also confirm the SA has roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and roles/storage.objectViewer.

govind: Quick look: secret exists but key id looks old (key-2023-11). That key likely expired/was revoked. We should create a new key and update the secret.

tian: I'll rotate the key now. Steps I'm going to run:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/ci-key.json \
  --iam-account=ci@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gh secret set GCP_SA_KEY --body-file=/tmp/ci-key.json --repo redwood-inference/infra
```

sam: Also ensure the SA still has the required roles (if not, add them):
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-inference \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-inference \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/storage.objectViewer
```

tian: Done. Created new key, updated GCP_SA_KEY secret, and verified IAM bindings. Kicking off rerun now.

ci-bot: Re-run started for run 1234567890 by tian. Job queued...

ci-bot: Job succeeded :white_check_mark: (gha-decrypt step now passing)

maya: :raised_hands: Nice — green now. Root cause appears to be the expired SA key combined with the runner upgrade removing cached creds. I'll add a key rotation checklist to the infra runbook.

sam: :eyes: Can we add an alert for keys older than 180 days so we catch this before it hits CI?

govind: Created issue #342 in infra: "ci: alert on old service account keys" and linked the runbook PR.
